texts.en:
After achieving complete dominion over the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership, our infiltration cells paved the way for the arrival of a formal first contact unit.

In a lavish ceremony held at the planetary capital, our diplomatic envoy graciously accepted a petition signed by every world leader on [infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]. The document calls for the immediate annexation of their [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] into the [root.GetName]. Jubilant citizens now crowd the streets, cheering their alien benefactors.
